section: Native CMJ measurement and assessment construction
exact_statement: Native measurement definitions and assessment chronology. (a) Analytical vertical force--time curve, not athlete data, generated with \(m=\SI{70}{\kilogram}\), \(g=\SI{9.80665}{\meter\per\second\squared}\), \(A=\SI{1000}{\newton}\), \(t_p=\SI{0.22}{\second}\) and \(T=\SI{0.55}{\second}\): \(F_z=mg+A\sin(\pi t/2t_p)\) for \(0\leq t\leq t_p\) and \(F_z=(mg+A)[1-(t-t_p)/(T-t_p)]\) for \(t_p<t\leq T\). Dividing the area under \(F_z\) by \(mT\) gives gross mean concentric force (\SI{14.79}{\Nkg}, black line); dividing the signed area relative to body weight by \(m\) gives gravity-adjusted net impulse (\SI{2.74}{\mps}). Peak force (\SI{24.09}{\Nkg}) is shown only to distinguish it from the scored mean-force target. (b) The three quantities with their equations, values and units. (c) Native contract (upper track): baseline search interval 24--240 h before the index exposure, from which the two latest valid assessments are selected, an H72 window at 66--78 h and a D7 window at 156--180 h; each assessment is the mean of three valid trials. Lower track: the separate public synthetic H24, H48 and H72 query horizons (nominal). No athlete measurements are plotted.
